description.value: A private lakeside resort sitting at the gateway to Bowron Lake Provincial Park's renowned 116 km canoe circuit, offering spacious lakefront and riverside campsites with showers and flush toilets; the final approach from Quesnel (~125 km) ends on gravel.

address.value: Bowron Lake, approximately 125 km east of Quesnel, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Bowron Lake Lodge is an active lakeside camping resort located approximately 125 km east of Quesnel, BC, primarily serving paddlers visiting Bowron Lake Provincial Park. The RV campsite page explicitly lists showers and flush toilets, covered community cooking areas, and firewood. Reservations are accepted via online booking (letscamp.ca), phone (250-255-2396), and email. No cycling-specific amenities or hiker/biker sites are mentioned. The lodge is on a dead-end road to the provincial park, making it a questionable fit for touring cyclists.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The lodge is an active campground with real amenities, but it sits on a dead-end road 125 km east of Quesnel leading to Bowron Lake Provincial Park. It primarily serves paddlers and canoeists rather than touring cyclists, and its remote location makes it unlikely to be on any cycling route.
